To summarize, the key findings of our research, stated in one sentence that includes all relevant information, are that

the microstructure and magnetic behavior of Ba-Pb hexa-ferrite (BxPb1− xFe12O19) particles play a significant role in the synergistic enhancement of the EMI shielding in Ba-Pb hex-ferrite-PANI-wax nanocomposites.
the synergistic effect of electrical and magnetic properties in the nanocomposite leads to enhanced EMI shielding.
the microstructure and magnetic property of the Ba-Pb-hexaferrites play a very crucial and synergistic role in enhancing absorption dominated EMI shielding in nanocomposite materials.
In summary, our research is concerned with
the development of nanocomposites with high EMI shielding efficiency (SE) and low specific attenuation (SA) in a very wide frequency band.
the development of a new class of electromagnetic shielding materials with enhanced EMI shielding properties.
the development of a new type of nanocomposites that can be used as efficient microwave absorbers in the 8-18 GHz band.
In summary, a comprehensive and detailed conclusive statement would be that

the synergistic effects of microstructural and magnetic properties of Ba-Pb hexagonal particles in combination with the conducting PANI in wax matrix are very crucial for enhancing absorption dominated electromagnetic shielding in our nanocomposites.

our developed nanocomposite materials are highly efficient in shielding the electromagnetic radiation in the microwave frequency range and are also very useful in controlling the electromagnetic smog.
the microstructure and the magnetic properties of the Ba-Pb-HF particles play a vital role in synergistically improving the EMI shielding behavior in the Ba-Pb-hexaferrites-PANI-Wax composites.
A comprehensive summary for our work would be that

the electromagnetic shielding behavior in our developed nanomaterials depends not only on the magnetic properties of the filler particles but also on its microstructure and the electrical properties of the filler.

the microstructure and magnetic characteristics of Ba-Pb hexa-ferrite play a very significant role in enhancing the absorption dominated EMI shielding in our developed Ba-Pb hex-ferrite-PANI wax nanocomposites.

the synergistic effect of the microstructure and magnetic behavior of the Ba-Pb-hexaferrites in conjunction with the electrical conductivity of the PANI and the microwave transparency of the wax matrix, is responsible for high absorption of the microwave radiation in the 8-18 GHz frequency band in the nanocomposite.
The main takeaway from our work is that
the microstructural, electrical and magnetic characteristics of the filler materials can be used as an effective tool in tailoring the EMI shielding behavior in nanocomposites.
we can tailor the microstructure and magnetic and electrical properties of the hexaferrite fillers and thereby enhance the absorption-dominated EMI shielding behavior in the nanocomposite.
the microstructure and magnetic property of the filler particles can be tailored to enhance EMI shielding performance of the nanocomposite.
